notes: wowsims-forever models one Hunter spell package for all three specs; Survival keeps the same Aimed Shot / Multi-Shot base as the other two, and, unlike Beast Mastery or Marksmanship, weaves in melee Raptor Strike -- the Survival tree's talents (Counterattack, Improved Wing Clip and the rest) are the ones that make standing in melee worthwhile. The cited Warcraft Tavern guide says outright that you should never prioritize Serpent Sting over an Aimed Shot or Multi-Shot cast; Serpent Sting is therefore ordered below both shots here, refreshed only once it is about to fall off and neither shot is close to ready, the same shape as hunter-marksmanship's. Raptor Strike is on-next-swing: its APL-castable queue is tag 3 (pipeline/apl.py's ON_NEXT_SWING_QUEUE_TAG, the odd one out among the on-next-swing abilities, which otherwise queue at tag 1), not the tag 1 that Heroic Strike, Cleave and Maul use, so it is cast with tag 3 here. It is gated on mana so it does not pull mana away from the ranged shots below 20 percent. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst: the shared preset names Multi-Shot as spell 25294, which does not exist in this build (Multi-Shot only has one rank here, 2643), and calls Serpent Sting rank 8 when 25295 is actually rank 9 -- both fixed here rather than copied stale.
